incidents.what_happened: A young doctor from Hyderabad on a trip with friends jumped into the Tungabhadra from a rock and was carried away by the current; her body was recovered the next day.
incidents.cause: jumped into river with strong current
incidents.quote: Ananya jumped into the river from an adjacent rock and a strong current carried her away, the police suspect.

incidents.what_happened: Three men attacked a group of tourists stargazing near Sanapur Lake, pushed the three men into the water and raped the two women; one male tourist drowned.
incidents.quote: The three men pushed the three male tourists into the Sanapur lake and sexually assaulted the two women, the SP had said.

incidents.what_happened: A 52-year-old French tourist slipped and fell while climbing a hill near the Mahanavami mound and was rescued after about two days.
incidents.quote: Bruno tried to climb the hill at around 6 pm on December 24 but slipped and fell.
